The Share of Minutes
Click 🎧 to listen.
Listen to a conversation between two students. The girl is discussing her opinion about two water designs for a desert farm. Listen carefully. You will hear the conversation only once. After listening, you will answer four questions about the conversation and the evidence the girl gives to support her opinion. As you listen, you may take notes.
Listen to the Conversation
1QUESTION 1:

2QUESTION 2:

3QUESTION 3:

4QUESTION 4:

Answer all 4 questions to submit.
Choose the best answer for each question. You may change your answers before submitting.
SMART SUPPORT:
Go back to the conversation. Listen again. Say the word design out loud each time the girl says it. Say the word share out loud each time she says it.
